text:
leo: FYI found a flaky gap in the Node sample: when auth fails and our retry replays the request the X-Request-ID sometimes shows up in logs even though the inbound scrub removed it. quick repro below.

leo: repro steps:
```
# start sample with debug logs
DEBUG=redwood:telemetry node samples/header-playground/server.js
# trigger failing auth then retry
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer nope' http://localhost:4100/ping
```

nina: ugh, do you have a paste of the logs where the id comes back?

leo: minimal sanitized snippet:
2026-03-24T11:05:10.010Z info telemetry inbound scrub X-Request-ID: <redacted>
2026-03-24T11:05:10.042Z warn auth auth-failed -> scheduling retry
2026-03-24T11:05:10.043Z debug retry-wrapper replaying headers: X-Request-ID=cc9f12
2026-03-24T11:05:10.044Z info http-response logged X-Request-ID=cc9f12

olga: that looks like retry is replaying a pre-scrub headers snapshot. which versions?

leo: node-sdk@1.8.2, otel-shim@0.4.2. retry-wrapper keeps headersSnapshot on first attempt for speed; OTEL inbound scrub mutates req.headers later, so the snapshot still has sensitive values.

sdk-bot: automated: security-notice created RW-1130 for header-snapshot replay leading to unredacted telemetry (severity: low).

nina: short-term options: 1) make retry read req.headers at replay time, 2) run redaction in a later outbound hook, or 3) have retry re-scrub headers before emitting.

leo: I tried option 1 locally (defer snapshot) and added a tiny integration test that simulates auth failure + retry and greps logs for X-Request-ID. test fails on main, passes with change.

olga: please mark the integration test flaky on windows and add it to samples CI. also add a small unit asserting retry does not reuse a cached pre-scrub header snapshot.

eng-platform: good catch. after the PR we should add an e2e parity job that runs node + python samples to catch SDK differences. file RW-1131 to track.

nina: can you include a short blurb in the changelog: "fix(node-sdk): avoid replaying pre-scrubbed headers in retry wrapper" and ping security for review?

leo: will open PR with failing test, fix, and passing test. pinging @olga and @nina for review. thanks!
